{{Top|leg}}
The '''Little Minos Run''' was an location in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that, by the time of the [[Bordal Contagion]] of [[214 BBY]], the head of [[Kett Shipping]] [[Findal Kett]] ran [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] across for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until the [[Hajara gang]] showed up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corva Yag/Legends|Corva Yag]] and began to capture the convoys.<ref name="EGtW:AC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>
